notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/jerrypeng0201__nebula --backend fake (exit 0, evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware run and no hardware is attached. The upstream is the SAPIEN PhysX SceneManipulation-v1 environment served with the pinned configuration robot_uids=fetch, control_mode=pd_joint_delta_pos, num_envs=1; the clone was never imported or run. The fake is a kinematic stand-in for that configuration: the action space is 13 normalized values in [-1, 1], and the observation is 30 unbatched values (15 qpos + 15 qvel). NOT COVERED: contacts, friction, actuator and controller dynamics, ReplicaCAD assets, rendering, cameras, get_state/set_state and snapshots, and the real batched (1, 30) observation; the fake's trajectories are not comparable with upstream and were never compared with it. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('SceneManipulation-v1', ...)) needs SAPIEN, torch and the ReplicaCAD assets and was not run. Warnings are the expected Gymnasium-family ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs; there are no G4 warnings. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests and no operator-required limits. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
